ext_description.message: Instant warnings on fake NFT mint and airdrop claim pages, and a check before risky wallet requests.

warning_title.message: This site is probably a wallet drainer

warning_proceed.message: I understand the risk, continue anyway

warning_proceed_confirm.message: This site is on a reviewed phishing list. Click again to continue anyway.

warning_note.message: Real projects host airdrop and mint flows on their official domain or on an address announced from their official X/Discord accounts. Do not trust "claim" links from X replies or DMs. Wallet connection and signature requests on this page can drain your funds.

popup_allow.message: I trust this site (add to allowlist)

popup_allow_confirm.message: This page made risky wallet requests. Click again to trust it anyway.

overlay_hint.message: Verify the address on the project's official X/Discord before connecting your wallet or signing anything.

popup_report_note.message: Optional: why do you think this is a scam?

popup_report_sent.message: Reported, thanks. It will be reviewed.

popup_scan_limited.message: This site was scanned recently or you reached today's scan limit. Try again later.

ai_err_cooldown.message: AI analysis is busy for this site. Try again in about $1 min.

ai_err_generic.message: AI analysis could not be completed right now.

ai_err_collect.message: This page could not be read.

ai_err_not_http.message: Only regular web pages (http or https) can be scanned.

popup_sandbox_sub.message: We opened the site with a throw-away wallet and watched what it asked for.

sbx_state_cache_hit.message: Sandbox not used — recent cached result.

sbx_state_blocklist.message: Sandbox not used — host already on the community blocklist.

sbx_state_chain_unsupported.message: Sandbox can't analyze this chain yet.

sbx_state_challenge.message: Could not inspect — the site blocks scanners

sbx_challenge_body.message: This page is hidden behind a bot check (e.g. Cloudflare), so our sandbox could not see what it really does. This does NOT mean it is safe — real drainers often hide this way. On a new or unknown site, do not connect your wallet unless you are sure.

sbx_inconclusive_body.message: The sandbox opened the site but saw no attack — a drain often fires only after a wallet connects, which we did not do. This page is already flagged as risky, so do NOT treat this as safe.

sbx_queue_waiting.message: In sandbox queue — position $1, ~$2s. We'll notify you.

sbx_queue_running.message: Sandbox is scanning this page now. We'll notify you.

sbx_queue_limit.message: Too many queued scans — try again in ~$1s.

sbx_queue_rate.message: Too many requests — try again in ~$1s.

sbx_clean_reassure.message: No wallet-harming behavior was seen on this site. The items below are just code observations, not threats.

sbx_markers_note.message: $1 code pattern also found in known drainer kits — not dangerous on its own

opt_warn_page.message: Yellow banner on the page and in the extension icon

opt_warn_popup.message: Only in the extension icon and popup (no banner on the page)

opt_warn_note.message: Dangerous pages (score 70+) always open the full-page warning regardless of this setting.

opt_simulate.message: Simulate held transactions through a public RPC (sends the pending transaction to publicnode / 1rpc / dRPC)

opt_api_help.message: The deep scan sends a snapshot of the page you are looking at (title, text sample, script names, link domains, wallet-related buttons) together with the extension's findings to this server, which asks an AI model for a verdict. It only happens when you press Deep scan. The AI key lives on the server, never in the extension.

opt_x_help.message: Optional. With an Xquik API key (xquik.com) the extension looks up the project's official X account for a suspicious domain and the account that shared the link. Only the project name or handle is sent, never the page you visit. Roughly 20 credits per new project name, cached for 7 days.

opt_test_fail.message: No result. Check the key and your credits.
